audit.why: Emerald+ 53.13% over 1167 games, matches the table.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect confirmed: the content layer never names a Gangplank ability — everything is "barrels", "his W", "his global R".
audit.why: Remove Scurvy in particular deserves its name, because it is the cooldown the whole lane turns on: it "cure[s] crowd control effects and restore[s] Health" on 22/20/18/16/14s. Tahm Kench's only kill tool is a stun; Gangplank carries a hard counter to it on a button. Naming Parrrley matters too — it is 625 range on a flat 4.5s, so the poke gap the entry describes as "his melee auto range" is really 275 units, not the length of the lane.
audit.corrected: Parrrley, Remove Scurvy, Powder Keg, Cannon Barrage and Trial by Fire now named across early, mid, late, spikes[0], spikes[1], whys[0], whys[1] and the full-layer cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0] make "Powder Kegs" the matchup-defining cooldown to track.
audit.why: Powder Keg is on a charge system, not a single cooldown you can count, and popping kegs is a farming concern rather than the thing that decides fights. The cooldown that actually gates Tahm Kench's win condition is Remove Scurvy — while it is up, no stun you land sticks. Also, the ability is "Powder Keg", singular; the data pluralises it.
audit.corrected: The tracked cooldown re-pointed to Remove Scurvy with its 22s rank-1 figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry repeatedly sells a "Q-stun then Devour" chain as one combo. In this matchup the ordering matters twice over, because Remove Scurvy cures the stun the moment it lands.
audit.why: Riot's own text in the kit: An Acquired Taste — "At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion"; Tongue Lash — "If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed." The stun and the swallow draw on the same three stacks, so a Q cast at 3 stacks stuns and destroys the resource Devour requires. The real sequence is to let Q land the THIRD stack (which does not stun) and then press R.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as: build to three, let Q apply the third stack, Devour immediately; a Q thrown at an enemy already on 3 stacks stuns but burns the swallow.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry credits Tahm Kench with "Abyssal Voyage" 3 time(s) and treats it as a global/roaming ultimate.
audit.why: Abyssal Voyage was removed in the Tahm Kench rework. The kit file lists W = Abyssal Dive and R = Devour; there is no global travel ability in the kit at all. Advice built on "use Abyssal Voyage to roam / reposition cross-map" tells the player to press a button that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Every reference re-pointed to Devour (R) or Abyssal Dive (W) as appropriate, with the surrounding advice rewritten so it describes what those abilities actually do.

audit.whatIsWrong: content win[] gives Level 1 to Tahm Kench and Levels 4-5 to Gangplank; full.phases[0].side says "Gangplank" and full.phases[3].side says "Tahm Kench" — both inverted.
audit.why: Two renderings of the same chart give opposite owners at two stages. Not edited; flagged for reconciliation.

edits.before: At level 1 your Tongue Lash range is your whole game plan — fire it into Gangplank every time he steps up to last-hit rather than sitting behind a barrel chain, and let Thick Skin passively absorb whatever barrel damage he retaliates with. You are not looking to all-in yet; you are fishing for stacks so that the first time he steps forward without a pre-placed barrel you can Q-stun him and Devour before his W even has a chance to fire. He cannot cleanse what he does not see coming. Deny him early CS and set the stage for the level 2-3 window where the stun goes live.
edits.after: At level 1 your Tongue Lash range is your whole game plan — fire it into Gangplank every time he steps up to last-hit rather than sitting behind a Powder Keg chain, and let Thick Skin absorb the Parrrley chip he answers with. You are not looking to all-in yet; you are fishing for stacks so that the first time he steps forward without a pre-placed barrel you can land the third stack and Devour before Remove Scurvy fires. A Q at 3 only stuns, and Remove Scurvy cures that. Deny him early CS and set the stage for the level 2-3 window where the stun goes live.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 are where Gangplank starts winning the poke war — his barrel chains hit harder and he can now reliably double or triple-barrel a path you have to walk through. Stop face-farming the wave through a pre-placed barrel; use Tongue Lash to last-hit at range and only step up when his barrel is visibly on cooldown. At level 6 his global R means you can never assume a fight is 1v1 if he has it up, and your own Abyssal Voyage gives you a way out of a collapsing side lane rather than an aggressive play — use it to reposition rather than dive deeper into his range.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 6 are where Gangplank starts winning the poke war — Powder Keg chains hit harder and he can reliably link two or three kegs across a path you have to walk through. Stop face-farming the wave through a pre-placed barrel; use Tongue Lash to last-hit at range and only step up when no keg is armed anywhere near you. At level 6 his global R means you can never assume a fight is 1v1 if he has it up, and your own Devour is a way to pull an ally out of a collapsing side lane rather than an aggressive play — Cannon Barrage is up every 160s at rank 1.

edits.before: By first item you are a durable frontliner but Gangplank's Tri-Force or Essence Reaver spikes his barrel burst hard enough to chunk you through grey health before Thick Skin can replenish it, and his W cleanses any stun you land so the Devour window is perpetually contested. Stop trying to solo-kill him and start playing for your team — Abyssal Voyage to protect your backline and interrupt his positioning, and let your 53% win rate advantage from lane translate into objective control rather than a duel you increasingly lose to his crit scaling.
edits.after: By first item you are a durable frontliner but Gangplank's Tri-Force or Essence Reaver spikes his barrel burst hard enough to chunk you through grey health before Thick Skin can replenish it, and Remove Scurvy cures any stun you land, and by rank 5 it is back every 14s. Stop trying to solo-kill him and start playing for your team — Devour to shield the backline that Cannon Barrage is falling on, and let your 53% win rate advantage from lane translate into objective control rather than a duel you increasingly lose to his crit scaling.

edits.before: Tongue Lash's range outpaces Gangplank's melee auto range — use it to contest the wave and stack An Acquired Taste on him before his barrels are efficient.
edits.after: Tongue Lash reaches 900 against Parrrley's 625 — use that gap to contest the wave and stack An Acquired Taste before his Powder Kegs get efficient.

edits.before: Three stacks into Q stun lets you Devour him mid-trade, removing him from the fight and erasing any heal his W could have granted.
edits.after: Land the third stack with Q and Devour immediately — a Q at 3 stuns instead, and Remove Scurvy cures that stun and heals him.

edits.before: Your Tongue Lash range safely pokes him while he is stuck in melee auto range, stacking An Acquired Taste without taking barrel retaliation.
edits.after: Your Tongue Lash range safely pokes him from 275 units past Parrrley, stacking An Acquired Taste before a Powder Keg is armed near you.

edits.before: At two stacks you can bait a melee trade, land the third-stack Q stun, and Devour him before his W cleanse fires — a full removal from the fight.
edits.after: At two stacks you can bait a melee trade, let Q land the third stack, then Devour before Remove Scurvy fires — a full removal from the fight.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gangplank Remove Scurvy: matchup-defining — Cures your stun, 22s at rank 1. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.after: Remove Scurvy cures it — bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
